# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package Build tool related. ### Is this a regression? I don't know. ### Description I'm writing a test in order to fix #29099. Unfortunately building and testing Angular doesn't seem too work, because the system never stops "Compiling Typescript". I tried `yarn bazel build //packages/compiler --profile filename_name.profile` and it too is going on for more than 32 minutes now. My machine is running Windows 10.
